title: A project's own copy of a delivered context is read in the delivered context's place
situation: Decision 0317 shows a project's own copy of a delivered context among the project's contexts, which the readings list after the practice place. A project holding the upstream cratylic context design itself but not the downstream workflow then reads the delivered workflow before its own cratylic context design: downstream before upstream. The delivered context is read upstream always before downstream, and a project holding it reads its own in its place.
decision: As 0317, except where a project's own copy is shown. The readings' practice place lists every delivered context the installation delivers, in the delivered order, origin then position; where the project's journal holds a live context whose identity is a delivered one's, its own copy stands in that place, named by its own name, unmarked, neither delivered nor read-only, recorded into as any of the project's contexts and part of its design. contexts lists the project's other contexts in record order. The practice place's description says so. A reading of one named context shows it in the place it has. With no delivered context given, every context of the journal is listed in contexts in record order. Closing the books still writes openings in record order.
consequences: Supersedes 0317. A project holding an upstream delivered context but not a downstream one reads its own upstream copy first, then the delivered downstream one, then the rest of its design; cratylus's own repository reads its cratylic context design, then its workflow, in the practice place, then its other contexts. One builder; review Ask.
